text:
Jordan: quick post-mortem from the chaos run: several EU tenants showed as "in-flight-handshake" and then the requests landed in us-west after a lease swap. we need clearer handshake semantics to avoid cross-region leakage.
Priya: yah, saw the same traces. root cause seemed to be a race between lease-revoke ack and the routing controller re-evaluating fallback rules.
Leila: can we treat the lease transfer as a two-phase commit? holder -> prepare(relinquish) -> ack -> commit(transfer). right now it's fire-and-forget.
Tomas: two-phase prevents races but adds latency. alternative: issue a short-lived transfer token that proxies validate for 200ms to accept late-arriving requests. token approach is idempotent and faster.
Jordan: transfer token idea is neat. token lifecycle needs to be explicit and observable though. also legal/residency must block tokens crossing zones for strict tenants.
Priya: agree. propose state machine: ACTIVE -> TRANSFERRING(token:{id,expires,allowed_regions}) -> TRANSFERRED. routing must reject accepts of token if tenant.residency.strict==true and allowed_regions != local.
Leila: and we should have an enforced token TTL < probe_window to avoid lingering acceptance. maybe TTL=250ms by default.
Tomas: telemetry hook requests: emit events `lease.transfer.initiated`, `lease.transfer.token_accepted`, `lease.transfer.token_rejected(reason)`, and tag with `residency_policy`. infra-bot can wire alerts if token_reject rate spikes.
infra-bot: noted. added temporary dashboard `lease-transfer-overview` with counters and 95th token-accept latency.
Jordan: operator behavior: when strict residency blocks transfer we should surface a clear operator signal and not fallback. ops-runbook should let on-call flip an emergency override but that requires legal approval.
Priya: config knobs I'm thinking for RFC: `transfer_token_ttl_ms`, `transfer_token_probe_window_ms`, `token_accept_policy` (ALLOW_SOFT_FALLBACK|BLOCK_STRICT), and `fallback_priority` list.
Leila: sample JSON config snippet for controller (will include in RFC):
```json
{
  "transfer_token_ttl_ms": 250,
  "transfer_probe_window_ms": 1000,
  "token_accept_policy": "BLOCK_STRICT",
  "fallback_priority": ["local_pool", "reserved_pool", "regional_warm_nodes", "cross_region"]
}
```
Tomas: tests: unit tests for token expiry and acceptance rules. e2e simulation should create a jittery network where revoke acks are delayed and verify no cross-region for `residency=STRICT`.
Priya: operational alerting: if `lease.transfer.token_rejected{reason="residency"}` > 0 for >2 tenants in 5m, page infra + legal. if `token_accepted` spikes to cross_region > 1% of transfers -> page SRE.
Leila: one more safety: controller must keep a short-lived blame log entry referencing the transfer token id and decision path. helps post-incident.
Jordan: agreed. action items: Priya draft mini-RFC with state machine and config keys, Leila add token lifecycle + tests to controller repo, Tomas add telemetry events to op-telemetry onboarding, infra-bot to create dash and alerts.
infra-bot: created alert rules: `lease_token_reject_count`, `lease_token_cross_region_rate`. dashboards: `lease-transfer-overview`.
Jordan: scheduling 30m follow-up tomorrow. tagging @Leila and @Tomas to own unit/e2e and telemetry. :rocket:
